about_short_description.short_description: Codi develops an AI workplace operations platform that automates office management, coordination, and employee requests for businesses.

product.name: Enterprise Membership Plan
product.description: A subscription-based service allowing businesses to book and manage private office spaces through the Codi Platform.

product.name: Managed Services
product.description: A platform service enabling clients to schedule, manage, and pay for office-related third-party services and item rentals without providing physical office space access.

product.name: AI Office Assistant
product.description: An AI-powered virtual assistant that manages office logistics and service requests to reduce administrative workload.

product.name: Office Cleaning Services
product.description: Scheduled cleaning services for office spaces including standard and touch-up cleaning options.

product.name: IT and Internet Services
product.description: Provision and management of office technology infrastructure including internet setup, video conferencing equipment, and IT support.

product.name: Pantry and Supplies Management
product.description: Automated delivery and restocking of office pantry items and essential supplies.
